title: Looking for a Pre Rigged Character Animator
author: Nyamakala_Fa
selftext:
Does anyone know of a tool I can use to import a rigged character and then ask AI to animate it for me? 

  
I know that there are several tools out there that can animate non rigged characters, or even generate everything from scratch, but I just dont trust AI to be able to produce the exact result I'm looking for unless I give it my character, the rigs, and the constraints on which it should move. 

In my head, it functions a bit like Spine 2d, or can use a Spine export to animate a game character I can then use in my projects.

comments.author: Ashamed-Cost-5548
comments.body: is your character already rigged in Spine?

replies.author: Nyamakala_Fa
replies.body: Yep! I get to that point, but when it comes to animating, I would really rather just let AI handle it. At least for the tedious stuff like running and walking

replies.author: DamnageBeats
replies.body: Did you try mixamo or its clone?

replies.author: Ashamed-Cost-5548
replies.body: Spine 2D has no AI integration so far. Also if you already righed it might as well animate it yourself. Your game looks simple enough hand animating it eill go long way
